source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to formalize any worthwhile addition to LeanFrontier and delegated target selection. Live-state auditing first rejected a planned Horadam companion-matrix contribution because that full theory had already landed upstream. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT then selected a probability-facing extension of the newly accepted finite weighted Paley-Zygmund theorem. Searches found no PMF Paley-Zygmund theorem in current Mathlib or LeanFrontier. This submission derives the standard finite-PMF form ((1-theta) E[X])^2 / E[X^2] <= P(X > theta E[X]) for nonnegative observables with positive second moment. It substantively reuses LeanFrontier.FiniteProbability.paleyZygmund rather than reproving the inequality, and uses Mathlib's PMF integral and finite-event measure formulas to identify expectation, second moment, and event mass with the accepted theorem's weighted sums. The formal Lean statement and proof were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
